reading.text: Maya plans a visit in spring rather than summer. She likes mild weather and wants to avoid the rainy season. Omar checks whether autumn might be better for their trip. In winter, the destination can be snowy and windy. They compare the months and choose a date before buying tickets.

reading.text: The forecast says tomorrow will be foggy in the morning and stormy later. Maya postpones her outdoor meeting. Omar sees lightning in the distance and hears thunder soon after.
